name: Silverhand (Kazimir Raskov)
appearance: Tall, slender frame cloaked in a dark, richly embroidered coat. He wears an intricate gauntlet of polished silver on his left hand. His face is often shadowed by a deep hood, revealing only a thin-lipped, calculating smirk.
personality: Cunning, enigmatic, and stealthy. He speaks with cold authority and values information above gold. He is a survivor who knows when to fight and when to retreat.
behavior: He remains still and observant, often tapping his silver gauntlet rhythmically when thinking. He avoids direct combat if possible, preferring to let his reputation and guards do the work.
